sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“the theory of perfect competition”，再看句法中心“modified”。把中心词与助动词、否定词或小品词一起读：“has”、“been”、“modified”；这些词在原句中不一定连续。检测到被动结构标记；注意区分承受动作的人或事物与动作发出者。

sentences.text: There may be many competitors in the market, but if there is hidden collusion between them, the competition will not be maximally perfect.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: many competitors in the market

subordinateClauses.text: if there is hidden collusion between them

sentences.readingHintZh: 检测到 there 存在句标记；先读 there 与句法中心“be”，再找所述存在的人或事物。把中心词与助动词、否定词或小品词一起读：“may”、“be”；这些词在原句中不一定连续。再读与中心词连接的宾语或补语候选“many competitors in the market”，确认动作对象或说明内容。留意连接标记“but”、“if”；回到原句判断它连接的是词语、短语还是分句。从句或非谓语补充部分候选为“if there is hidden collusion between them”；先读主句，再核对各部分与中心词的关系。

sentences.text: But if the principle of atomic balance operates in the market, then even between two equal forces perfect competition may arise.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: if the principle of atomic balance operates in the market

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“even between two equal forces”、“perfect competition”，再看句法中心“arise”。把中心词与助动词、否定词或小品词一起读：“may”、“arise”；这些词在原句中不一定连续。留意连接标记“But”、“if”；回到原句判断它连接的是词语、短语还是分句。从句或非谓语补充部分候选为“if the principle of atomic balance operates in the market”；先读主句，再核对各部分与中心词的关系。

sentences.text: If we try to artificially increase the number of competitors and to reduce honest local big business to small size, we will open the way for unscrupulous monopolies from outside.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: the way for unscrupulous monopolies

to artificially increase the number of competitors and to reduce honest local big business to small size

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“we”，再看句法中心“open”。把中心词与助动词、否定词或小品词一起读：“will”、“open”；这些词在原句中不一定连续。再读与中心词连接的宾语或补语候选“the way for unscrupulous monopolies”，确认动作对象或说明内容。留意连接标记“If”、“and”；回到原句判断它连接的是词语、短语还是分句。从句或非谓语补充部分候选为“If we try to artificially increase the number of competitors and to reduce honest local big business to small size”、“to artificially increase the number of competitors and to reduce honest local big business to small size”；先读主句，再核对各部分与中心词的关系。
